<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Prayer Times</title>
<style>
/* Static .woff fonts are listed (not the variable .woff2) because the 2018 Samsung TV browser
   cannot set weights on variable fonts and drew every weight the same, thinner.
   Masjid prayer display - light "paper" theme.
   Sized in viewport-height units so it fills any 16:9 TV resolution.
   Fonts are bundled in /fonts (SIL Open Font License), no internet needed. */

@font-face {
  font-family: "Cormorant";
  src: url("fonts/cormorant-500.woff") format("woff");
  font-weight: 500; font-style: normal;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Cormorant";
  src: url("fonts/cormorant-600.woff") format("woff");
  font-weight: 600; font-style: normal;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter";
  src: url("fonts/inter-300.woff") format("woff");
  font-weight: 300; font-style: normal;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter";
  src: url("fonts/inter-400.woff") format("woff");
  font-weight: 400; font-style: normal;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter";
  src: url("fonts/inter-600.woff") format("woff");
  font-weight: 600; font-style: normal;
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Cormorant";
  src: url("fonts/cormorant-700.woff") format("woff");
  font-weight: 700; font-style: normal;
}
@font-face { font-family: "Manrope"; src: url("fonts/manrope-400.woff") format("woff"); font-weight: 400; }
@font-face { font-family: "Manrope"; src: url("fonts/manrope-500.woff") format("woff"); font-weight: 500; }
@font-face { font-family: "Manrope"; src: url("fonts/manrope-600.woff") format("woff"); font-weight: 600; }
@font-face { font-family: "Manrope"; src: url("fonts/manrope-800.woff") format("woff"); font-weight: 800; }

@font-face { font-family: "Gelasio"; src: url("fonts/gelasio-700.woff") format("woff"); font-weight: 700; }
@font-face { font-family: "ManropeHeavy"; src: url("fonts/manrope-800.woff") format("woff"); font-weight: 800; }

@font-face {
  font-family: "Amiri";
  src: url("fonts/amiri-700.woff2") format("woff2"), url("fonts/amiri-700.woff") format("woff");
  font-weight: 700; font-style: normal;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #e9e6e0;
  color: #1a2e26;
  font-family: "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  cursor: none;
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums;
  -webkit-font-feature-settings: "lnum"; font-feature-settings: "lnum";
}
.hidden { display: none !important; }

#app {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 2.4vh 1.6vw 2.2vh;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 40% 40%, #f7f5f1 0%, #eeebe5 55%, #e3dfd8 100%);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------ shared light box */
.box {
  background: #fbfaf8;
  border-radius: 1.6vh;
  box-shadow: 0 0.4vh 1.6vh rgba(70, 60, 40, 0.08), 0 0.1vh 0.3vh rgba(70, 60, 40, 0.05);
}
.small-caps { font-size: 1.9vh; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1a2e26; }
.gdot {
  display: inline-block; width: 0.6vh; height: 0.6vh; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #b8963e; vertical-align: middle; margin: 0 1vh 0.3vh;
}
.ornament {
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
  -webkit-justify-content: center; justify-content: center;
}
.ornament .line { width: 3.5vw; height: 0.12vh; background: #d9cfb8; margin: 0 1vw; }
.ornament .dot { width: 0.6vh; height: 0.6vh; border-radius: 50%; background: #b8963e; margin: 0 0.5vh; }
.ornament .dot.big { width: 1vh; height: 1vh; }

/* ------------------------------------------------ header */
.topbar {
  position: relative;
  -webkit-flex: 0 0 auto; flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 1.6vh 2vw 1.8vh;
}
/* name (and optional subtitle) on the left, both dates stacked on the right */
.topbar {
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-justify-content: space-between; justify-content: space-between;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
}
.tb-right .hijri { margin-top: 0.4vh; }
.org-sub:empty { display: none; }
.tb-orn {  /* ornament sits in the exact centre of the header */
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%;
  -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
.org-name { font-family: "Cormorant", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.8vh; color: #1a2e26; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.org-sub { font-size: 2.2vh; font-weight: 600; color: #4b5563; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.greg { font-size: 3.6vh; font-weight: 600; color: #1a2e26; text-align: right; }
.hijri {
  font-family: "Cormorant", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 3.6vh; color: #185640; text-align: right;
  /* no joined "Th" letters */
  -webkit-font-variant-ligatures: none; font-variant-ligatures: none;
  -webkit-font-feature-settings: "lnum" 1, "liga" 0, "dlig" 0; font-feature-settings: "lnum" 1, "liga" 0, "dlig" 0;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------ middle */
.middle {
  position: relative;
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 auto; flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  margin: 1.4vh 0 2.2vh;
  min-height: 0;
}
.left {
  -webkit-flex: 0 0 48%; flex: 0 0 48%;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  padding-right: 1.4vw;
}
.right {
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 auto; flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

.clock-wrap {
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 auto; flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  -webkit-justify-content: center; justify-content: center;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
}
.clock {
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
  font-family: "ManropeHeavy", "Manrope", "Inter", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 22vh;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #185640;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.clock-side {
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  margin-left: 1.2vw;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.clock-sec { font-family: "ManropeHeavy", "Manrope", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 8vh; color: #b8963e; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.clock-ampm { font-family: "ManropeHeavy", "Manrope", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 5.6vh; color: #4b5563; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 0.4vh; }

.next-card { padding: 0.9vh 1.4vw 1vh; text-align: center; }
.next-countdown { font-family: "Manrope", "Inter", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 8.4vh; font-weight: 600; color: #1a2e26; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.next-sub { font-size: 2.4vh; font-weight: 600; color: #4b5563; }
.next-card.soon .next-countdown { color: #185640; -webkit-animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }

/* ------------------------------------------------ daily content panel */
.panel {
  position: relative;
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 auto; flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  border-radius: 2vh;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8f7f4 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 1vh 3.5vh rgba(70, 60, 40, 0.12), 0 0.2vh 0.5vh rgba(70, 60, 40, 0.05);
  padding: 2.4vh 2.4vw 2.6vh;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.panel-body {
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 auto; flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
  -webkit-justify-content: center; justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  -webkit-transition: opacity 0.6s; transition: opacity 0.6s;
}
.panel-body.fading { opacity: 0; }
.pill {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.9vh 2.2vw;
  border-radius: 3vh;
  background: #185640;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 1.7vh;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  position: relative;
}
.pill:before, .pill:after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 0.6vh; height: 0.6vh; margin-top: -0.3vh;
  border-radius: 50%; background: #d9b85c;
}
.pill:before { left: 1.1vw; }
.pill:after { right: 1.1vw; }
.content-arabic { font-size: 3.6vh; color: #185640; margin-top: 2vh; direction: rtl; line-height: 1.5; }
.content-arabic:empty { display: none; }
.content-text {
  font-family: "Cormorant", Georgia, serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 4.3vh;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: #1a2e26;
  margin-top: 2.2vh;
}
.panel-body.medium .content-text { font-size: 3.8vh; }
.panel-body.long .content-text { font-size: 3.3vh; }
.panel-body.xlong .content-text { font-size: 2.9vh; }
.content-ref { margin-top: 1.6vh; font-size: 1.4vh; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b7280; }
.right { -webkit-flex-direction: row; flex-direction: row; }
.right-main {
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 auto; flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
}
.right-side {
  -webkit-flex: 0 0 auto; flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  margin-left: 1.2vw;
}
.under-panel {
  height: 3.4vh;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
  -webkit-justify-content: center; justify-content: center;
}
.content-dots span {
  display: inline-block; width: 0.8vh; height: 0.8vh; border-radius: 50%;
  margin: 0 0.8vh; background: #cfd4da;
}
.content-dots span.on { background: #185640; }

/* phone notice (slim green bar) */
.notice {
  -webkit-flex: 0 0 auto; flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
  -webkit-justify-content: center; justify-content: center;
  background: #2b6049;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 1.4vh;
  padding: 1.1vh 1vw;
  margin-top: 1.4vh;
  font-size: 1.9vh;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.3;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.notice-icon { width: 3.6vh; height: 3.6vh; margin-right: 0.8vw; -webkit-flex: 0 0 auto; flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* one slim card holding both QR codes (donation + community), stacked */
.qr-card {
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 auto; flex: 1 1 auto;
  padding: 1vh 0.9vw;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
  -webkit-justify-content: center; justify-content: center;
}
.qr-item { text-align: center; }
.qr-sep { width: 60%; height: 0.12vh; background: #e4dccb; margin: 1vh 0; -webkit-flex: 0 0 auto; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.qr-box {
  position: relative;
  width: 19vh; height: 19vh;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: #ffffff;
}
.qr-box img { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.qr-missing {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-align-items: center; align-items: center;
  -webkit-justify-content: center; justify-content: center;
  text-align: center; font-size: 1.3vh; color: #9aa0a6; border: 0.15vh dashed #cfd4da;
}
.qr-caption { margin-top: 0.7vh; font-size: 1.85vh; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1a2e26; white-space: nowrap; }
.qr-caption:empty { display: none; }

.ap {  /* stacked AM / PM */
  display: inline-block;
  width: 0.7em;
  font-size: 0.26em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  font-weight: 400;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: bottom;
  margin-left: 0.25em;
  margin-bottom: 0.35em;
  word-break: break-all;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------ Adhan / Iqamah alert (covers the middle area) */
.alert {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  z-index: 5;
  border-radius: 2vh;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f6f4ef 100%);
  -webkit-animation: fadein 0.8s ease-out, glowblue 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  animation: fadein 0.8s ease-out, glowblue 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.alert-arabic { font-size: 7vh; color: #185640; margin-top: 2.4vh; line-height: 1.4; }
.alert-title { font-family: "Cormorant", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12vh; line-height: 1.05; color: #1a2e26; }
.alert-sub { font-size: 2.8vh; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 2.4vh; }
.alert.iqamah .alert-sub {
  letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; font-style: italic; font-size: 3.4vh;
  color: #ffffff; background: #2b6049; padding: 1.6vh 3vw; border-radius: 1.2vh;
}


/* ------------------------------------------------ header colour (green band, matches the prayer cards) */
.topbar.box {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0d2a20 0%, #123528 50%, #0d2a20 100%);
  border: 0.2vh solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 0.6vh 2vh rgba(15, 42, 34, 0.25);
}
.topbar .org-name { color: #f6f0e1; }
.topbar .org-sub { color: #c6d9cf; }
.topbar .greg { color: #f6f0e1; }
.topbar .hijri { color: #f1d27a; }
.topbar .ornament .line { background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5); }

/* ------------------------------------------------ night mode (sunset to sunrise, set by app.js) */
#app, .box, .panel, .notice, .clock, .next-countdown, .content-text {
  -webkit-transition: background 2s, color 2s, box-shadow 2s; transition: background 2s, color 2s, box-shadow 2s;
}
body.night, body.night #app {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 40% 40%, #0f2820 0%, #0a1f18 55%, #071611 100%);
}
body.night .box, body.night .panel {
  background: #102c23;
  box-shadow: 0 0.6vh 2vh rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35), inset 0 0 0 0.12vh rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}
body.night .topbar.box { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0a2119 0%, #0d2a20 50%, #0a2119 100%); }
body.night .clock { color: #ffffff; }
body.night .clock-ampm, body.night .clock-sec { color: #ffffff; }
body.night .small-caps { color: #d5e0da; }
body.night .next-countdown { color: #ffffff; }
body.night .next-card.soon .next-countdown { color: #8fd1b0; }
body.night .next-sub { color: #a8bdb3; }
body.night .content-text { color: #f1ece0; }
body.night .content-arabic { color: #8fd1b0; }
body.night .content-ref { color: #a8bdb3; }
body.night .content-dots span { background: #2b4a3e; }
body.night .content-dots span.on { background: #8fd1b0; }
body.night .notice { background: #22513c; }
body.night .qr-caption { color: #f1ece0; }
body.night .qr-sep { background: #2b4a3e; }
body.night .qr-missing { color: #6f8a7e; border-color: #2b4a3e; }
body.night .alert { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #15382c 0%, #102c23 100%); }
body.night .alert-title { color: #f4efe2; }
body.night .alert-arabic { color: #8fd1b0; }
body.night .alert-sub { color: #a8bdb3; }

/* ------------------------------------------------ prayer cards (original design - keep as is) */
.prayers {
  -webkit-flex: 0 0 31vh; flex: 0 0 31vh;
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  font-family: "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #f4efe2;
}
.prayers small { font-size: 0.5em; margin-left: 0.25em; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.card {
  position: relative;
  -webkit-flex: 1 1 0; flex: 1 1 0;
  margin: 0 0.5vw;
  border-radius: 1.4vh;
  padding: 1.6vh 1vw 1.4vh;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17, 54, 42, 0.92) 0%, rgba(9, 32, 25, 0.92) 100%);
  border: 0.2vh solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35);
  display: -webkit-box; display: -webkit-flex; display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: column; flex-direction: column;
  -webkit-justify-content: space-between; justify-content: space-between;
  text-align: center;
  -webkit-transition: background 0.6s, opacity 0.6s; transition: background 0.6s, opacity 0.6s;
}
.card:first-child { margin-left: 0; }
.card:last-child { margin-right: 0; }
.card-head { line-height: 1.1; }
.card-name { display: block; font-family: "Gelasio", Georgia, serif; font-size: 4.4vh; font-weight: 700; color: #f1d27a; }
.card-ar { display: block; font-size: 3vh; color: #e9dcc0; margin-top: 0.3vh; }
.card-tag {
  position: absolute; top: -1.4vh; left: 50%;
  -webkit-transform: translateX(-50%); transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-size: 1.8vh; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.3vh 1vw; border-radius: 1vh;
  background: #d4af37; color: #3a0c18; white-space: nowrap;
}
.card-tag:empty { display: none; }
.card-row { display: block; }
.card-row .lbl { display: block; font-size: 1.9vh; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b9ab8b; }
.card-row .val { display: block; font-family: "Manrope", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 4.6vh; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; }
.card-row.jam .val { font-size: 5.4vh; font-weight: 800; color: #f1d27a; }
.card-row .see { font-size: 2.4vh; font-weight: normal; color: #e9dcc0; }
.card .sep { display: inline-block; width: 0.8vw; }
.card.multi .card-row .val { font-size: 3.4vh; }
.card.multi .card-row.jam .val { font-size: 3.6vh; }
.card.jumuah { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17, 54, 42, 0.92) 0%, rgba(9, 32, 25, 0.92) 100%); }

.card.past { opacity: 0.55; }
.card.next {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f3d77f 0%, #d4af37 100%);
  border-color: #fff3c4;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3vh rgba(241, 210, 122, 0.45);
}
.card.next .card-name, .card.next .card-row.jam .val { color: #4a1020; }
.card.next .card-ar, .card.next .card-row .lbl, .card.next .see { color: #5a3a1a; }
.card.next .card-row .val { color: #1a2620; }
.card.next .card-tag { background: #7b1e34; color: #f8e9b8; }
.card.alerting { -webkit-animation: glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; animation: glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }

/* ------------------------------------------------ start overlay + errors */
.error {
  position: fixed; left: 10vw; right: 10vw; top: 20vh; z-index: 30;
  padding: 4vh 3vw; border-radius: 2vh;
  background: #fff4f4; color: #5a0d0d; border: 0.5vh solid #b3261e;
  font-size: 3vh; line-height: 1.5;
}
.error h1 { font-size: 5vh; margin-bottom: 2vh; }
.error p { margin-top: 1vh; }
.error .small { font-size: 2.2vh; opacity: 0.8; }
.error.small-box { top: auto; bottom: 2vh; font-size: 2.2vh; padding: 2vh 2vw; }
.error.small-box h1 { font-size: 3vh; margin-bottom: 1vh; }

/* ------------------------------------------------ full-screen Iqamah screen */
.iq {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 40;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #14233a;
  font-family: "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-animation: fadein 1.2s ease-out; animation: fadein 1.2s ease-out;
}
.iq-bg, .iq-photo { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.iq-bg {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 88% 8%, rgba(190, 219, 238, 0.95) 0%, rgba(190, 219, 238, 0) 38%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 22% 30%, rgba(244, 212, 178, 0.9) 0%, rgba(244, 212, 178, 0) 55%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, #f7ebdb 0%, #f5efe6 50%, #eee3d1 100%);
}
.iq-photo { object-fit: cover; display: none; }

/* "half" photos: the whole photo is shown on the side away from the text, and a soft blurred
   copy of it fills the screen behind the text, so a wide building never sits under the words */
.iq-blur {
  position: absolute; top: -6%; left: -6%; width: 112%; height: 112%;
  /* only the top (sky) of the photo, stretched and blurred, so no buildings show up blurry */
  background-size: 170% 330%; background-position: center top;
  -webkit-filter: blur(4vh); filter: blur(4vh);
  display: none;
}
.fit-half.has-photo .iq-blur { display: block; }
.fit-half .iq-photo { top: auto; bottom: 0; width: 58vw; height: auto; }
.fit-half.side-right .iq-photo {
  left: 0;

<script>
/* Phone updates: whenever the TV has internet (e.g. a phone hotspot) it reads the published times sheet,
   the announcements sheet and any display version published from the laptop.
   Runs before app.js. The last good copy of each is saved on the TV, so it works with no internet.
   Anything with a mistake is ignored completely and the TV keeps what it already has. */
(function () {
  var RU = (window.CONFIG && CONFIG.remoteUpdates) || {};
  var STORE = 'masjid.sheetUpdate', ANN_STORE = 'masjid.announcements', FLASH = 'masjid.sheetFlash';
  var B_HTML = 'masjid.bundleHtml', B_VER = 'masjid.bundleVersion', B_BAD = 'masjid.bundleBad', B_TRIES = 'masjid.bundleTries';
  var CHECK_MS = 60 * 1000;

  function read(k) { try { return window.localStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }
  function write(k, v) { try { window.localStorage.setItem(k, v); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } }
  function clear(k) { try { window.localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }

  function parseCsv(text) {
    var rows = [], row = [], cell = '', q = false, i, c;
    text = text.replace(/^﻿/, '');
    for (i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      c = text.charAt(i);
      if (q) {
        if (c === '"' && text.charAt(i + 1) === '"') { cell += '"'; i++; }
        else if (c === '"') { q = false; }
        else { cell += c; }
      } else if (c === '"') { q = true; }
      else if (c === ',') { row.push(cell); cell = ''; }
      else if (c === '\n') { row.push(cell); rows.push(row); row = []; cell = ''; }
      else if (c !== '\r') { cell += c; }
    }
    row.push(cell); rows.push(row);
    return rows;
  }

  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }

  // "8:00 PM", "8:00:00 PM" or 24-hour "20:00" / "06:40". A bare "8:00" is refused: AM or PM?
  function parseTime(v) {
    var m = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\s*([ap])\.?m?\.?$/i.exec(v), h, mi;
    if (m) {
      h = +m[1]; mi = +m[2];
      if (h < 1 || h > 12 || mi > 59) { return null; }
      h = h % 12 + (m[3].toLowerCase() === 'p' ? 12 : 0);
      return pad(h) + ':' + pad(mi);
    }
    m = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?$/.exec(v);
    if (!m) { return null; }
    h = +m[1]; mi = +m[2];
    if (h > 23 || mi > 59 || (m[1].length === 1 && h < 13)) { return null; }
    return pad(h) + ':' + pad(mi);
  }

  // a time, or minutes after Adhan ("+5"; Google Sheets turns +5 into 5)
  function parseRule(v) {
    var m = /^\+?(\d{1,3})$/.exec(v);
    return m ? '+' + (+m[1]) : parseTime(v);
  }

  var FIELDS = {
    'fajr iqamah': ['fajr', parseRule], 'dhuhr iqamah': ['dhuhr', parseRule], 'asr iqamah': ['asr', parseRule],
    'maghrib iqamah': ['maghrib', parseRule], 'isha iqamah': ['isha', parseRule],
    'jumuah adhan': ['khutbah', parseTime], 'jumuah salah': ['jamaah', parseTime]
  };

  // returns { values, css } or { error }. Anything that is not our sheet (a login page etc.) is an error.
  function parseSheet(text) {
    var rows = parseCsv(text), out = { values: {}, css: '' }, i, label, value, f, r;
    if (!rows.length || String(rows[0][0]).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '').toLowerCase() !== 'setting') { return { error: 'not the display sheet' }; }
    for (i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
      label = String(rows[i][0] || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/['’]/g, '');
      value = String(rows[i][1] || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
      if (!label || !value) { continue; }
      if (label === 'iqamah screen minutes') {
        if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(value) || +value <= 0 || +value > 30) { return { error: rows[i][0] }; }
        out.values.iqamahMinutes = +value;
      } else if (label === 'design css') {
        if (value.indexOf('<') !== -1) { return { error: rows[i][0] }; }
        out.css = value;
      } else if (FIELDS[label]) {
        f = FIELDS[label]; r = f[1](value);
        if (!r) { return { error: rows[i][0] }; }
        out.values[f[0]] = r;
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  // "11/7", "11/7/2026" or "2026-11-07" -> "2026-11-07"
  function parseDate(v) {
    var m = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})(?:\/(\d{2}|\d{4}))?$/.exec(v), y;
    if (m) {
      y = m[3] ? (m[3].length === 2 ? 2000 + (+m[3]) : +m[3]) : new Date().getFullYear();
      if (+m[1] < 1 || +m[1] > 12 || +m[2] < 1 || +m[2] > 31) { return null; }
      return y + '-' + pad(+m[1]) + '-' + pad(+m[2]);
    }
    return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v) ? v : null;
  }

  function trim(v) { return String(v || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, ''); }

  // columns: Priority, Title, When, Where, Details, Start, End
  function parseAnnouncements(text) {
    var rows = parseCsv(text), list = [], i, pr, title, st, en;
    if (!rows.length || trim(rows[0][0]).toLowerCase() !== 'priority') { return { error: 'not the announcements sheet' }; }
    for (i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
      title = trim(rows[i][1]);
      if (!title) { continue; }
      pr = trim(rows[i][0]); st = trim(rows[i][5]); en = trim(rows[i][6]);
      if ((pr && !/^\d+$/.test(pr)) || (st && !parseDate(st)) || (en && !parseDate(en))) { return { error: 'Announcements row ' + (i + 1) }; }
      list.push({
        priority: pr ? +pr : 99, title: title, when: trim(rows[i][2]), where: trim(rows[i][3]), text: trim(rows[i][4]),
        start: st ? parseDate(st) : '', end: en ? parseDate(en) : '', row: i
      });
    }
    return { list: list };
  }

  function apply(u) {
    var C = window.CONFIG, v = u.values || {}, k;
    C.iqamah = C.iqamah || {};
    for (k in { fajr: 1, dhuhr: 1, asr: 1, maghrib: 1, isha: 1 }) { if (v[k]) { C.iqamah[k] = v[k]; } }
    if (C.jumuah && C.jumuah[0]) {
      if (v.khutbah) { C.jumuah[0].khutbah = v.khutbah; }
      if (v.jamaah) { C.jumuah[0].jamaah = v.jamaah; }
    }
    if (v.iqamahMinutes) { C.iqamahScreen = C.iqamahScreen || {}; C.iqamahScreen.minutes = v.iqamahMinutes; }
    if (u.css) {
      var st = document.createElement('style');
      st.appendChild(document.createTextNode(u.css));
      document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(st);
    }
  }

  var toastTimer = null;
  function toast(msg, bad) {
    var el = document.getElementById('updateToast');
    if (!el) { return; }
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.className = 'update-toast' + (bad ? ' bad' : '');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { el.className = 'update-toast hidden'; }, 30000);
  }

  // apply what is saved on the TV now, before the display starts
  var savedText = read(STORE), saved;
  if (savedText) {
    saved = parseSheet(savedText);
    if (saved.error) { clear(STORE); savedText = null; } else { apply(saved); }
  }

  window.ANNOUNCEMENTS = [];
  var savedAnn = read(ANN_STORE), annParsed;
  if (savedAnn) {
    annParsed = parseAnnouncements(savedAnn);
    if (annParsed.error) { clear(ANN_STORE); savedAnn = null; } else { window.ANNOUNCEMENTS = annParsed.list; }
  }

  if (RU.enabled === false) { return; }

  function restart() {
    write(FLASH, '1');
    window.location.replace('index.html' + window.location.search);
  }

  var wasOnline = false, shownError = null;
  function get(url, ok) {
    var x = new XMLHttpRequest(), done = false;
    function failed() { if (!done) { done = true; wasOnline = false; } }
    x.onreadystatechange = function () {
      if (x.readyState !== 4 || done) { return; }
      if (x.status !== 200) { failed(); return; }
      done = true;
      var first = !wasOnline;
      wasOnline = true;
      ok(x.responseText, first);
    };
    try {
      x.open('GET', url + (url.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') + 't=' + Date.now(), true);
      x.timeout = 20000;
      x.ontimeout = failed;
      x.onerror = failed;
      x.send();
    } catch (e) { failed(); }
  }
  function report(err) {
    if (shownError !== err) { shownError = err; toast('Update not applied: check "' + err + '" in the sheet', true); }
  }
  function settled(first) { if (first && !shownError) { toast('Up to date'); } }
  function saveAndRestart(key, text, first) {
    if (write(key, text)) { restart(); } else if (first) { toast('Update could not be saved on this TV', true); }
  }

  function checkSheet() {
    if (!RU.sheetUrl) { return; }
    get(RU.sheetUrl, function (text, first) {
      var r = parseSheet(text);
      if (r.error) { report(r.error); return; }
      if (text !== savedText) { saveAndRestart(STORE, text, first); } else { settled(first); }
    });
  }
  function checkAnnouncements() {
    if (!RU.announcementsUrl) { return; }
    get(RU.announcementsUrl, function (text, first) {
      var r = parseAnnouncements(text);
      if (r.error) { report(r.error); return; }
      if (text !== savedAnn) { saveAndRestart(ANN_STORE, text, first); } else { settled(first); }
    });
  }
  // a new display version published from the laptop: version.txt is tiny, bundle.json only when it changes
  function checkBundle() {
    var base = RU.publishUrl;
    if (!base) { return; }
    base = base.replace(/\/$/, '');
    get(base + '/version.txt', function (text, first) {
      var v = trim(text);
      if (!/^[\w.-]{1,40}$/.test(v) || v === read(B_VER) || v === read(B_BAD)) { settled(first); return; }
      get(base + '/bundle.json', function (json) {
        var b = null;
        try { b = JSON.parse(json); } catch (e) { /* ignored below */ }
        if (!b || b.version !== v || typeof b.html !== 'string' || b.html.indexOf('id="clockHM"') === -1) { return; }
        if (write(B_HTML, b.html) && write(B_VER, v)) {
          clear(B_TRIES);
          restart();
        } else { toast('Update could not be saved on this TV', true); }
      });
    });
  }
  function check() { checkSheet(); checkAnnouncements(); checkBundle(); }

  if (read(FLASH)) { clear(FLASH); toast('Updated'); wasOnline = true; }
  check();
  setInterval(check, CHECK_MS);
  window.addEventListener('online', check, false);
})();

</script>

   Port of the PrayTimes.org v2.3 astronomical algorithm (Hamid Zarrabi-Zadeh, LGPL),

    ISNA:    { fajr: 15,   isha: 15 },
    MWL:     { fajr: 18,   isha: 17 },
    Egypt:   { fajr: 19.5, isha: 17.5 },

  function tan(d) { return Math.tan(dtr(d)); }

      dhuhr: midDay(t.dhuhr),
      asr: asrTime(asrFactor, t.asr),
      sunset: sunAngleTime(riseSet, t.sunset),

      if (!isMin(params.maghrib)) { r.maghrib = adj(r.maghrib, r.sunset, num(params.maghrib)); }
    }

    if (isMin(params.isha)) { r.isha = r.maghrib + num(params.isha) / 60; }

    for (k in r) { r[k] += (num(a[k]) / 60); }
    return r;
  }

    var h = Hijri.toHijri(hd, opt(DISP, 'hijriAdjustDays', 0));
    hijriText = h.day + ' ' + h.monthName + ' ' + h.year;
    setText('hijriDate', hijriText);
  }

  function renderClock(n) {
    var p = fmtParts(n);
    setText('clockHM', p.t);
    setText('clockSec', pad(n.getSeconds()));
    setText('clockAmPm', p.ap);
  }

  function renderCards(n, next) {
    var showTomorrowFajr = next && next.day === tomorrow;
    for (var i = 0; i < PRAYERS.length; i++) {
      var k = PRAYERS[i].key;
      var src = (k === 'fajr' && showTomorrowFajr) ? tomorrow : today;
      setHtml('beg-' + k, fmtHtml(src.adhan[k]));
      var jumuahToday = k === 'dhuhr' && src.isFriday && src.jumuah.length;
      setText('jlbl-' + k, 'Jamaah');
      setHtml('jam-' + k, jumuahToday ? '<span class="see">See ' + JUMUAH_NAME + '</span>' : fmtHtml(src.iqamah[k]));

      var cls = 'card';
      var tag = '';
      if (next && next.ev.key === k) {
        cls += ' next';
        tag = (src.adhan[k] && n >= src.adhan[k]) ? 'Jamaah soon' : 'Next';
      } else if (src === today && today.iqamah[k] && n >= today.iqamah[k] && !jumuahToday) {
        cls += ' past';
      } else if (jumuahToday && today.adhan.dhuhr && n >= today.adhan.dhuhr) {
        cls += ' past';
      }
      if (k === 'fajr' && showTomorrowFajr) { tag = 'Tomorrow'; }
      if (alertUntil > n.getTime() && currentAlert && currentAlert.key === k) { cls += ' alerting'; }
      setClass($('card-' + k), cls);
      setText('tag-' + k, tag);
    }

    if ($('card-jumuah')) {
      var js = today.jumuah, beg = [], jam = [];
      for (i = 0; i < js.length; i++) { beg.push(fmtHtml(js[i].khutbah)); jam.push(fmtHtml(js[i].jamaah)); }
      var sep = '<span class="sep"></span>';
      setHtml('beg-jumuah', beg.join(sep));
      setHtml('jam-jumuah', jam.join(sep));
      var jc = 'card jumuah' + (js.length > 1 ? ' multi' : '');
      var jtag = today.isFriday ? 'Today' : 'Fridays';
      if (next && next.ev.key === 'jumuah') { jc += ' next'; jtag = 'Next'; }
      else if (today.isFriday && js.length && js[js.length - 1].jamaah && n >= js[js.length - 1].jamaah) { jc += ' past'; }
      if (alertUntil > n.getTime() && currentAlert && currentAlert.key === 'jumuah') { jc += ' alerting'; }
      setClass($('card-jumuah'), jc);
      setText('tag-jumuah', jtag);
    }
  }

  function renderNext(n, next) {
    if (!next) { setText('nextSub', ''); setText('nextCountdown', '--:--:--'); return; }
    var e = next.ev, d = next.day;
    var secs = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((e.time - n) / 1000));
    setText('nextCountdown', pad(Math.floor(secs / 3600)) + ':' + pad(Math.floor(secs / 60) % 60) + ':' + pad(secs % 60));
    setText('nextSub', e.name + (d === tomorrow ? ' (tomorrow)' : '') + ' \u2022 ' + fmt(e.time));
    setClass($('nextCard'), 'box next-card' + (secs <= 600 ? ' soon' : ''));
  }


  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- daily rotating content
  function list(name) { return (typeof window[name] !== 'undefined' && window[name] && window[name].length) ? window[name] : []; }
  var CONTENT = [
    { label: 'Verse of the Day', items: list('VERSES') },
    { label: 'Hadith of the Day', items: list('HADITH') },
    { label: 'Dua of the Day', items: list('DUAS') }
  ].filter(function (c) { return c.items.length > 0; });
  var contentIdx = 0, contentDayKey = null, contentShownAt = 0;

  function renderContent(n, force) {
    if (!CONTENT.length) { return; }
    var rotateMs = opt(DISP, 'contentRotateSeconds', 20) * 1000;
    var t = n.getTime();
    var k = dayKey(n);
    if (!force && k === contentDayKey && t - contentShownAt < rotateMs) { return; }
    if (k === contentDayKey && !force) { contentIdx = (contentIdx + 1) % CONTENT.length; }
    contentDayKey = k;
    contentShownAt = t;

    // deterministic daily pick: whole days since 1970 (local calendar date)
    var dayNum = Math.floor(Date.UTC(n.getFullYear(), n.getMonth(), n.getDate()) / 86400000);
    var c = CONTENT[contentIdx];
    var item = c.items[dayNum % c.items.length] || {};
    var text = item.text || '';

    var card = $('contentBody');
    card.className = 'panel-body fading' + (currentAlert ? ' hidden' : '');
    setTimeout(function () {
      $('contentKind').textContent = c.label;
      $('contentArabic').textContent = item.arabic || '';
      $('contentText').textContent = text;
      $('contentRef').textContent = item.ref || '';
      var size = text.length > 260 ? ' xlong' : text.length > 170 ? ' long' : text.length > 90 ? ' medium' : '';
      var dots = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < CONTENT.length; i++) { dots += '<span' + (i === contentIdx ? ' class="on"' : '') + '></span>'; }
      $('contentDots').innerHTML = CONTENT.length > 1 ? dots : '';
      card.className = 'panel-body' + size + (currentAlert ? ' hidden' : '');
    }, force ? 0 : 600);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- alerts
  // Adhan: banner over the middle area.  Iqamah: full-screen "It's Dhuhr time" screen.
  var currentAlert = null, iqEvent = null, iqUntil = 0;
  var ADHAN_AR = 'حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاة';

  function checkAlerts(n) {
    var t = n.getTime();
    var evs = today.events;
    for (var i = 0; i < evs.length; i++) {
      var e = evs[i];
      var dur = (e.type === 'adhan' ? opt(DISP, 'adhanAlertMinutes', 4) : opt(IQS, 'minutes', 10)) * 60000;
      var id = e.type + e.key + e.time.getTime();
      var since = t - e.time.getTime();
      if (since >= 0 && since < dur && !fired[id]) {
        fired[id] = true;
        if (e.type === 'adhan') { showAlert(e, e.time.getTime() + dur); } else { showIqamah(e, e.time.getTime() + dur); }
      }
    }
    if (currentAlert && t >= alertUntil) { hideAlert(); }
    if (iqEvent && t >= iqUntil) { hideIqamah(); }
  }

  function showAlert(e, until) {
    currentAlert = e;
    alertUntil = until;
    $('alertPill').textContent = 'Adhan';
    $('alertArabic').textContent = ADHAN_AR;
    $('alertTitle').textContent = 'Time for ' + e.name;
    var iq = today.iqamah[e.key];
    if (e.key === 'dhuhr' && today.isFriday && today.jumuah.length) { iq = today.jumuah[0].jamaah; }
    $('alertSub').textContent = iq ? 'Iqamah at ' + fmt(iq) : '';
    $('alertBox').className = 'panel-body alert adhan';
    $('contentBody').className = 'panel-body hidden';
  }
  function hideAlert() {
    currentAlert = null;
    alertUntil = 0;
    $('alertBox').className = 'panel-body alert hidden';
    renderContent(now(), true);
  }

  // prayer names with full vowel marks for the big calligraphy on the Iqamah screen
  var IQ_AR = {
    fajr: 'الفَجْر', dhuhr: 'الظُّهْر', asr: 'العَصْر',
    maghrib: 'المَغْرِب', isha: 'العِشَاء', jumuah: 'الجمعة'
  };
  function arabicName(key) {
    if (key === 'jumuah') { return JUMUAH_AR; }
    for (var i = 0; i < PRAYERS.length; i++) { if (PRAYERS[i].key === key) { return PRAYERS[i].ar; } }
    return '';
  }

  /** Background photo for the Iqamah screen: media/iqamah/<prayer>.jpg (or .png).
      Jumu'ah uses dhuhr. Where the text goes on each photo comes from
      iqamahScreen.photoLayout in config.js. With no photo, the drawn masjid is shown. */
  var NO_PHOTO_LAYOUT = { side: 'right', text: 'dark', fit: 'full' };
  function layoutClass(L, hasPhoto) {
    L = L || NO_PHOTO_LAYOUT;
    return 'iq side-' + (L.side === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right') +
      ' text-' + (L.text === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark') +
      (L.fit === 'half' ? ' fit-half' : '') +
      (hasPhoto ? ' has-photo' : '');
  }
  function setIqamahPhoto(key) {
    var name = key === 'jumuah' ? 'dhuhr' : key;
    var base = 'media/iqamah/' + name;
    var photo = $('iqPhoto');
    var usePhoto = function (on) {
      photo.style.display = on ? 'block' : 'none';
      $('iqMosque').style.display = on ? 'none' : '';
      if (iqEvent) { $('iqScreen').className = layoutClass(on ? (IQS.photoLayout || {})[name] : null, on); }
    };
    usePhoto(false);
    photo.onload = function () {
      $('iqBlur').style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + photo.getAttribute('src') + '")';
      usePhoto(true);
    };
    photo.onerror = function () {
      if (photo.getAttribute('src') === base + '.jpg') { photo.setAttribute('src', base + '.png'); }
      else { usePhoto(false); }
    };
    photo.setAttribute('src', base + '.jpg');
  }

  function showIqamah(e, until) {
    iqEvent = e;
    iqUntil = until;
    $('iqAr').textContent = IQ_AR[e.key] || arabicName(e.key);
    $('iqName').textContent = e.name;
    $('iqLine1').textContent = opt(IQS, 'line1', 'Straighten your rows');
    $('iqLine2').textContent = opt(IQS, 'line2', 'and silence your phones');
    renderIqamah(now());
    setIqamahPhoto(e.key);
  }
  function renderIqamah(n) {
    if (!iqEvent) { return; }
    var p = fmtParts(n);
    setText('iqHM', p.t);
    setText('iqAP', p.ap);
    setText('iqDate', hijriText + '  |  ' + WEEKDAYS[n.getDay()].slice(0, 3) + ', ' + MONTHS[n.getMonth()].slice(0, 3) + ' ' + n.getDate());
  }
  function hideIqamah() {
    iqEvent = null;
    iqUntil = 0;
    $('iqScreen').className = 'iq hidden';
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- remote / fullscreen
  function goFullscreen() {
    var el = document.documentElement;
    if (document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement) { return; }
    var fn = el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullScreen || el.msRequestFullscreen;
    if (!fn) { return; }
    try {
      var p = fn.call(el);
      if (p && p['catch']) { p['catch'](function () { /* not allowed: ignore */ }); }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  // any remote button / click asks for full screen (browsers only allow it after a button press)
  document.addEventListener('keydown', goFullscreen, false);
  document.addEventListener('click', goFullscreen, false);

  // testing photos on the TV: remote keys 1-5 show that prayer's Iqamah screen for 20 seconds
  // (1 Fajr, 2 Dhuhr, 3 Asr, 4 Maghrib, 5 Isha)
  var TEST_KEYS = { 49: 'fajr', 50: 'dhuhr', 51: 'asr', 52: 'maghrib', 53: 'isha' };
  try {
    if (window.tizen && tizen.tvinputdevice) { for (var tk = 1; tk <= 5; tk++) { tizen.tvinputdevice.registerKey(String(tk)); } }
  } catch (e) { /* not a TV: keyboard 1-5 still works */ }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
    var k = TEST_KEYS[ev.keyCode];
    if (k && window.MasjidDisplay) { window.MasjidDisplay.previewIqamah(k, 20 / 60); }
  }, false);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- anti burn-in + keep awake
  var SHIFTS = [[0, 0], [4, 2], [-3, 4], [2, -4], [-4, -2], [3, 3], [-2, 1], [1, -3]];
  var shiftIdx = 0;
  function shiftPixels() {
    if (!opt(DISP, 'antiBurnIn', true)) { return; }
    shiftIdx = (shiftIdx + 1) % SHIFTS.length;
    var v = 'translate(' + SHIFTS[shiftIdx][0] + 'px,' + SHIFTS[shiftIdx][1] + 'px)';
    var s = $('app').style;
    s.webkitTransform = v;
    s.transform = v;
  }
  function keepAwake() {
    // best effort; only exists when installed as a Tizen app, harmless otherwise
    try { if (window.tizen && tizen.power) { tizen.power.request('SCREEN', 'SCREEN_NORMAL'); } } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    // Samsung TV app: stop the TV's screen saver from covering the display
    try {
      if (window.webapis && webapis.appcommon) {
        webapis.appcommon.setScreenSaver(webapis.appcommon.AppCommonScreenSaverState.SCREEN_SAVER_OFF);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- night mode
  // dark colours from sunset until sunrise (display.nightModeAfterSunset in config.js)
  var isNight = null;
  function renderNight(n) {
    var on = opt(DISP, 'nightModeAfterSunset', true) && !!today.adhan.sunset && !!today.adhan.sunrise &&
      (n >= today.adhan.sunset || n < today.adhan.sunrise);
    if (/[?&]night=1/.test(window.location.search)) { on = true; }
    if (/[?&]night=0/.test(window.location.search)) { on = false; }
    if (on !== isNight) {
      isNight = on;
      document.body.className = on ? 'night' : '';
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- overnight black screen
  // black from (Isha Iqamah + N min) until (Fajr Adhan - N min); sleepScreen in config.js
  var SLEEP = C.sleepScreen || {};
  var isSleep = null;
  function renderSleep(n) {
    var on = false;
    if (opt(SLEEP, 'enabled', true) && today.iqamah.isha && today.adhan.fajr) {
      var start = addMinutes(today.iqamah.isha, opt(SLEEP, 'minutesAfterIshaIqamah', 60));
      var end = addMinutes(today.adhan.fajr, -opt(SLEEP, 'minutesBeforeFajrAdhan', 60));
      on = n >= start || n < end;
    }
    if (/[?&]sleep=1/.test(window.location.search)) { on = true; }
    if (/[?&]sleep=0/.test(window.location.search)) { on = false; }
    if (on !== isSleep) {
      isSleep = on;
      $('sleepScreen').className = on ? 'sleep' : 'sleep hidden';
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- announcements slide
  // rotates with the main screen, one event at a time; lower priority number first.
  // Stays away during alerts, the Iqamah screen and the minutes before an Iqamah.
  var ANN_MAIN = opt(DISP, 'announcementEverySeconds', 180) * 1000;
  var ANN_EACH = opt(DISP, 'announcementShowSeconds', 10) * 1000;
  var ANN_QUIET = opt(DISP, 'announcementQuietMinutesBeforeIqamah', 10) * 60000;
  var ANN_MAX_TABS = 6;
  var annStart = Date.now(), annPage = 0, annOn = false, annTabsKey = null, annEventKey = null;
  // content/announcements.js, used while the announcements sheet has nothing
  var fileAnnouncements = (window.ANNOUNCEMENTS_FILE || []).map(function (a, k) {
    return {
      priority: a.priority || 99, title: String(a.title || ''), when: String(a.when || ''), where: String(a.where || ''),
      text: String(a.details || ''), image: a.image || '', imageCaption: String(a.imageCaption || ''),
      start: a.start || '', end: a.end || '', row: 'f' + k
    };
  }).filter(function (a) { return a.title; });
  function activeAnnouncements(n) {
    var key = n.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(n.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(n.getDate());
    var list = (window.ANNOUNCEMENTS && window.ANNOUNCEMENTS.length) ? window.ANNOUNCEMENTS : fileAnnouncements;
    return list.filter(function (a) {
      return (!a.start || key >= a.start) && (!a.end || key <= a.end);
    }).sort(function (a, b) { return (a.priority - b.priority) || (a.row - b.row); });
  }
  function esc(t) { return String(t).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>'); }
  function renderAnnStrip(n, next) {
    var p = fmtParts(n), nextKey = next ? next.ev.key : null, html = '';
    setText('annHM', p.t);
    setText('annAP', p.ap);
    function col(key, name, adhan, iqamah) {
      var A = adhan ? fmtParts(adhan).t : '--', Q = iqamah ? fmtParts(iqamah).t : '--';
      html += '<div class="ann-p' + (nextKey === key ? ' next' : '') + '"><div class="ann-pn">' + name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="ann-row"><span>ADHAN</span><b>' + A + '</b></div>' +
        '<div class="ann-row q"><span>IQAMAH</span><b>' + Q + '</b></div></div>';
    }
    var js = today.jumuah.length ? today.jumuah[0] : null;
    col('fajr', 'Fajr', today.adhan.fajr, today.iqamah.fajr);
    col('dhuhr', 'Dhuhr', today.adhan.dhuhr, today.isFriday && js ? js.jamaah : today.iqamah.dhuhr);
    col('asr', 'Asr', today.adhan.asr, today.iqamah.asr);
    col('maghrib', 'Maghrib', today.adhan.maghrib, today.iqamah.maghrib);
    col('isha', 'Isha', today.adhan.isha, today.iqamah.isha);
    if (js) { col('jumuah', JUMUAH_NAME, js.khutbah, js.jamaah); }
    setHtml('annTimes', html);
  }
  function renderAnnouncements(n, next) {
    var all = activeAnnouncements(n), show = false, a = null, group = [], i = 0;
    var nearIqamah = next && (next.ev.time - n) <= ANN_QUIET;
    if (all.length && !currentAlert && !iqEvent && !nearIqamah) {
      var pages = Math.ceil(all.length / ANN_MAX_TABS);
      group = all.slice((annPage % pages) * ANN_MAX_TABS, (annPage % pages + 1) * ANN_MAX_TABS);
      var at = Date.now() - annStart - ANN_MAIN;
      if (at >= group.length * ANN_EACH) {
        annPage++;              // finished: back to the main screen, next group of events next time
        annStart = Date.now();
      } else if (at >= 0) {
        i = Math.floor(at / ANN_EACH);
        a = group[i];
        show = !!a;
      }
    }
    if (show !== annOn) {
      annOn = show;
      setClass($('annSlide'), show ? 'ann' : 'ann hidden');
      $('app').className = show ? 'ann-showing' : '';
    }
    if (!show) { annEventKey = null; return; }
    renderAnnStrip(n, next);
    var tabsKey = group.map(function (g) { return g.row; }).join(',') + '/' + i;
    if (tabsKey !== annTabsKey) {
      annTabsKey = tabsKey;
      $('annTabs').innerHTML = group.map(function (g, k) {
        return '<div class="ann-tab' + (k === i ? ' on' : k < i ? ' done' : '') + '"><div class="ann-tt">' + esc(g.title) + '</div>' +
          (g.when ? '<div class="ann-tw">' + esc(g.when) + '</div>' : '') + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      setClass($('annTabs'), 'ann-tabs' + (group.length > 4 ? ' many' : ''));
    }
    if (annEventKey !== a.row) {
      annEventKey = a.row;
      $('annTitle').textContent = a.title;
      $('annWhen').textContent = a.when + (a.when && a.where ? ' \u2022 ' : '') + a.where;
      $('annText').textContent = a.text;
      var size = a.text.length > 320 ? ' xlong' : a.text.length > 180 ? ' long' : '';
      setClass($('annDetail'), 'ann-detail' + size + (a.title.length > 28 ? ' long-title' : '') + (a.image ? ' with-pic' : ''));
      // picture (e.g. a QR code) beside the text; hidden if the file is missing
      var pic = $('annPic'), img = $('annImg');
      pic.className = 'ann-pic hidden';
      img.onload = img.onerror = null;
      if (a.image) {
        $('annImgCap').textContent = a.imageCaption;
        if (img.getAttribute('src') === a.image && img.complete && img.naturalWidth) {
          pic.className = 'ann-pic';  // same picture as last time: no new load event
        } else {
          img.onload = function () { pic.className = 'ann-pic'; };
          img.onerror = function () { pic.className = 'ann-pic hidden'; };
          img.src = a.image;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- main loop
  function tick() {
    var n = now();
    var newDay = ensureDays(n);
    var next = findNext(n);
    renderClock(n);
    renderDates(n);
    renderNight(n);
    renderSleep(n);
    checkAlerts(n);
    renderIqamah(n);
    renderCards(n, next);
    renderNext(n, next);
    renderContent(n, newDay);
    renderAnnouncements(n, next);
  }

  function loop() {
    try { tick(); } catch (e) { if (window.console) { console.error(e); } }
    setTimeout(loop, 1000 - (Date.now() % 1000) + 15);
  }

  function initStatic() {
    var org = C.organization || {};
    $('orgName').textContent = org.name || '';
    $('orgSub').textContent = org.subtitle || '';
    document.title = (org.name || 'Masjid') + ' • Prayer Times';

    $('qrCaption').textContent = opt(DON, 'caption', '');
    var notice = opt(DISP, 'phoneNotice', 'Please ensure your mobile phone is silent in the prayer hall.');
    if (notice) { $('noticeText').textContent = notice; } else { $('phoneNotice').style.display = 'none'; }
    var img = $('qrImg');
    img.onload = function () { $('qrMissing').style.display = 'none'; img.style.display = ''; };
    img.onerror = function () { img.style.display = 'none'; $('qrMissing').style.display = ''; };
    img.src = opt(DON, 'qrImage', 'media/qr.png');
    var COMM = C.community || {};
    $('commCaption').textContent = opt(COMM, 'caption', 'Join our WhatsApp');
    var cimg = $('commImg');
    cimg.onload = function () { $('commMissing').style.display = 'none'; cimg.style.display = ''; };
    cimg.onerror = function () { cimg.style.display = 'none'; $('commMissing').style.display = ''; };
    cimg.src = opt(COMM, 'qrImage', 'media/community-qr.png');


    var contentErrs = loadErrorsFor('content/');
    if (contentErrs.length) {
      fatal('<h1>A content file has a typo</h1><p>' + contentErrs.join('<br>') +
        '</p><p>The display is still running; fix the file and reload.</p>');
      $('errorBox').className = 'error small-box';
    }
  }

  initStatic();
  buildCards();
  keepAwake();
  loop();
  setInterval(shiftPixels, 3 * 60 * 1000);

  // debug hook for testing in a desktop browser: MasjidDisplay.buildDay(new Date(2026, 0, 1))
  // preview the Iqamah screen for 1 minute:  MasjidDisplay.previewIqamah('asr')
  window.MasjidDisplay = {
    buildDay: buildDay, showAlert: showAlert, showIqamah: showIqamah,
    previewIqamah: function (key, minutes) {
      var P = { fajr: 'Fajr', dhuhr: 'Dhuhr', asr: 'Asr', maghrib: 'Maghrib', isha: 'Isha', jumuah: JUMUAH_NAME };
      if (!P[key]) { key = 'dhuhr'; }
      showIqamah({ type: 'iqamah', key: key, name: P[key], time: now() }, Date.now() + (minutes || 1) * 60000);
    }
  };

  // checking photos: open index.html?iqamah=asr to see that prayer's Iqamah screen for 10 minutes
  var q = /[?&]iqamah=(\w+)/.exec(window.location.search);
  if (q) { window.MasjidDisplay.previewIqamah(q[1].toLowerCase(), 10); }
  // index.html?adhan=asr shows the Adhan banner for that prayer
  var qa = /[?&]adhan=(\w+)/.exec(window.location.search);
  if (qa) {
    var AN = { fajr: 'Fajr', dhuhr: 'Dhuhr', asr: 'Asr', maghrib: 'Maghrib', isha: 'Isha' };
    var ak = AN[qa[1].toLowerCase()] ? qa[1].toLowerCase() : 'asr';
    showAlert({ type: 'adhan', key: ak, name: AN[ak], time: now() }, Date.now() + 10 * 60000);
  }
})();
